headline.purpose: Card headers - 0.78x display, its own step.

body.purpose: All running text and form content.

label.purpose: Eyebrow labels, badge text, field labels. Uppercase where used.

mono.purpose: Codes, weights, and data values - so numbers read as data, not prose.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Accent fill, square corners, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2360c4; color: #ffffff; padding: 0 16px; height: 36px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d55ac; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2360c4; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action alongside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #f2f4f7; color: #14161b; padding: 0 16px; height: 36px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e9ecf1; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2360c4; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Delete/remove actions. Uses the AA-safe strong red, never the display Alert Red.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: #c0392b; color: #ffffff; padding: 0 16px; height: 36px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: #a5311f; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2360c4; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Hairline border, square corners, accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #14161b; border: 1px solid #c8cdd5; border-radius: 0; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #aab0ba; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #2360c4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(35,96,196,0.3); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat, hairline-bordered container. No shadow at rest.
components.html:
Shift type
Day 07:00-19:00, 12h, minimum 3 nurses.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #c8cdd5; border-radius: 0; } .ds-card-header { font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; padding: 20px 20px 4px; color: #14161b; } .ds-card-body { padding: 0 20px 20px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #4a515c; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic status indicator. Tint fill, matching border and ink text so meaning never depends on hue alone.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #eafaf1; border: 1px solid #1f9a5c; color: #14161b; border-radius: 0; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }

components.name: Success Toast
components.description: Signature component. Ink-dark surface, on-ink text, floating side shadow, and the one deliberate side-stripe exception in the whole system.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #14161b; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #14161b; border-left: 3px solid #1f9a5c; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: -16px 0 40px rgba(20,30,50,.18); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 16px; } .ds-toast-icon { color: #5fcf94; }

narrative.overview: This is a precise, purpose-built tool for shift scheduling, not a consumer app and not a cold clinical terminal. Every squared-off edge (radius: 0 everywhere, no exceptions) reads as engineered discipline rather than decoration: this is an instrument a ward manager operates with confidence, the same way a calibrated device earns trust through precision, not ornament. The top chrome bar stays dark in both light and dark theme, an always-on instrument-panel reference point that never flips with the rest of the surface. The palette is restrained: near-white paper and pure-white cards, ink-dark text, a single user-selectable accent, and status color reserved strictly for meaning. Type pairs a confident display face (Figtree) against a plain, highly-legible body face (Hanken Grotesk), with a monospace face reserved for codes, weights, and data values.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners everywhere (radius: 0), no exceptions, ever.
Flat by default: cards, panels, and inputs carry a hairline border, never a shadow.
One user-selectable accent color drives brand, focus rings, and links; status colors are reserved for meaning only.
Figtree for display/headings, Hanken Grotesk for body/UI, Spline Sans Mono for codes and data values.
A fluid type scale stepping up at six breakpoints, baked at a fixed 0.9 density multiplier.
Two independent, deliberately disjoint breakpoint ladders: type and layout - never conflate them.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Exactly one accent color is live at a time, user-selected from four options. Brand-tint fills are always derived from that single accent via a fixed mix formula.

rules.name: The Redundant Signal Rule
rules.body: Status is never carried by color alone: every status badge pairs its tint with an ink-dark text color and a matching border.

rules.name: The Negative-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Every heading-weight face carries -0.02em letter-spacing; every uppercase label carries +0.03em.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow is permitted only on a surface that visually floats above the rest of the page (toast, dialog, drawer). A resting card, panel, or input never gets one.

dos: Do keep every corner at radius: 0 - cards, buttons, inputs, badges, dialogs, the drawer. No exceptions.
Do use a hairline border as the default separation for resting surfaces instead of a shadow.
Do reserve shadow for genuinely floating surfaces only: toast, dialog, side drawer.
Do pair every status color with matching text/border so meaning never depends on hue alone.
Do use the Alert Red Strong fill, not the display Alert Red, for any destructive action button.
Do route every new component through the tokens above - no hard-coded hex, no default shadcn blue.
Do use the layout ladder for grid/form breakpoints, and the type ladder for everything else.
donts: Don't ship a generic SaaS dashboard cliche - no gradient hero metrics, no glowing stat tiles, no glassmorphism-as-default.
Don't make it read as cold clinical hospital software - sterile and intimidating is a failure state.
Don't introduce playful-consumer-app cues - no rounded bubbly shapes, no mascots, no bright primary colors outside the defined palette.
Don't let anything look like an unstyled shadcn default.
Don't use a colored left/right border stripe as a decorative accent, except the one narrow success-toast exception ported from the canonical prototype.
Don't use gradient text or any background-clip: text treatment.
Don't snap a layout grid to the nearest type-ladder breakpoint instead of its own layout-ladder value.
